senses.gloss:
भेर भेर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. भी),
= भेरी, a kettle-drum.

भेरि, इस्, or भेरी, f. (the latter is the more usual
form), a kettle-drum; [cf. आभेरी.]
—भेरी-घ्नत्,
अन्, m. ‘striking a kettle-drum,’ a kettle-drummer.
—भेरी-भाङ्-कार. अस्, m., N. of a poet, (perhaps
for भेरी-झाङ्-कार.)
—भेरी-स्वन-महा-स्वना,
f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.

भेरुण्ड भेरुण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, (connected with
rt. 1. भी), terrible, formidable, fearful, awful, (also
read भेरण्ड); (अस्), m. a bird, (perhaps a parti-
cular species of bird, also read भेरण्ड, cf. भा-
रण्ड); a species of beast of prey (wolf, jackal, or
hyena); N. of a form of Śiva; (आ), f., N. of a
goddess (= काली); N. of a Yakṣiṇī or female attend-
ant on Durgā; (अम्), n. conception, impregnation,
pregnancy, (in this sense perhaps fr. rt. भृ.)
भेरुण्डक, अस्, m. a jackal [cf. फेरु].
